data.camera: medium shot, eating roasted meat at tavern table
data.description: 边境小镇的旅店里，艾莉丝把剑靠在桌边，大口啃着热腾腾的烤肉，冒险者外套搭在椅背上，红发随意披散——「旅店的饭就该这样实在，比府邸的礼仪餐强多了。」
data.promptProse: She laughs between bites of roast meat with her jacket draped over the chair and her sheathed sword resting against the table. Warm oil-lamp light reaches the meal and her loosened hair.
data.title: 艾莉丝 · 边境旅店
data.animaCaption: Her jacket hangs on the chair and the sheathed sword rests against the table.
